title: Third time
html_source: Bloom saw Boylan earlier in chapter 6 on D'Olier Street and in chapter 8 on his way to the National Library.

anchor.prefix: s. Smoke mermaids, 1986#216coolest whiff of all. Hair streaming: lovelorn. For some man. For Raoul. He eyed and saw afar on Essex bridge a gay hat riding on a jaunting car. It is.
anchor.suffix:
. Coincidence. 

1961#263

 Jingling on supple rubbers it jaunted from the bridge to Ormond quay. Follow. Risk it. Go quick. At four. Near now. Out. 

 — Twopence, sir, the shopgir
